class.name: MaszynaPlugin
class.brief_description: MaSzyna's vehicles and sceneries for Rails Reloaded.
class.description: The vehicles simulated on MaSzyna's vendored Mover, its E3D models, and the original's scenery, scenario, signalling and cab formats. Its servers are [MaszynaE3DParser], [MaszynaE3DRenderingServer], [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] and [PythonScreenServer].
